summary: Iteration 2 retest. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass, including 4 new retests: duplicate-photo flag on both the case and the report after submit, review on a returned report gives 400, draft followed by first submit is version 1 with no leftover draft, and dashboard stats. Non-xlsx import gives 400. Frontend at 390x844 as AGT102: forced password change works. Back buttons work: case-detail-back-btn goes to /home or /cases, and report-back-btn goes to the case detail. Report inputs show 'Required' or empty, and the page has no 'Optional' text. The status pill is not clipped (x 296-374). The KPI grid fills the width (2x175px). Save Draft changes the pill from Assigned to In Progress, on both the report screen and the case detail. Admin at 1920x1080: login and dashboard work, Agent Productivity shows 'Unassigned', the cases list loads, opening a submitted case shows Under Review, and Approve with a comment gives Approved with export buttons. MIS export (daily/weekly/monthly) returns 200 xlsx. One minor issue is left: on web, a long unbroken value (e.g. Client Case ID 'TEST_residence_applicant_599e5c') still runs past the case detail card's right padding. No deprecated Expo packages found.

ui_bugs.issue: Long values with no spaces (Client Case ID) run past the card's right padding on case detail at 390px. flex:1 does not wrap a long single token on web.

issues: Timeline entries show raw JSON metadata (e.g. {"source":"manual"}, {"agent":...,"reason":""}). Format these as readable text.
The action label says 'Report Approve'. It should be 'Report Approved'.
The success toast spans the whole width and covers the sidebar footer and the export buttons for a few seconds.
The map preview is about 180px wide and centered, not full card width (cosmetic).

action_items: LOW: In DisplayRow, add minWidth:0 and, on web, wordBreak:'break-word' (or overflowWrap:'anywhere') to the value Text so long single tokens wrap inside the card.
LOW: Show timeline metadata as readable text instead of raw JSON, and rename 'Report Approve' to 'Report Approved'.
LOW (optional): On the admin web layout, keep the toast to the content area or make it narrower so it doesn't cover the sidebar and buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: The admin case review screen ((admin)/cases/[id].tsx) has no BackHeader. That is fine on web because the sidebar is there, but there is no back button to the filtered cases list.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retest items (1 minor overflow left)
